text:
maria: Quick question — when a Dedicated pool evicts a tenant (burst overflow), what should the Private-sidecar proxy do if it still has a live connection to the runtime? We have ambiguity between re-routing to Hosted fallback vs failing fast. Thoughts?

nate: Fail fast surfaces errors to apps quickly but breaks longer-running sessions. Hosted fallback keeps app alive but has data residency / privacy implications. Tradeoff depends on tenant policy.

sasha: We need a policy matrix. For tenants with a `no-exfil` flag, can't go to Hosted at all. For others, fallback allowed if model + quantization compatibility is verified.

lee: Proposal: sidecar checks eviction reason. If resource_shortage && tenant_allows_fallback -> route to hosted model variant with a `traceable-fallback` header. If eviction reason == security/ban -> immediate 403. Minimal probing during handshake only.

devon: Operational question: what happens to KV cache? You can't migrate it. We should emit a user-facing warning and truncate session or warm a new cache in hosted (best-effort). UX will complain about context loss.

maria: Can we define a tiny handshake flow snippet? e.g. sidecar on EVICT -> POST /controlplane/handshake { tenant_id, eviction_reason, model, session_id } -> response { allowed: bool, target_model: string?, token?: string, deny_reason?: string } or deny. If allowed, sidecar switches route + injects `x-fallback-info`.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: canary deploy of `sidecar-fallback-v3` scheduled tomorrow 09:00 UTC. See http://deploys/1234 :rocket:

nate: Add latency budgeting into the handshake. Hosted fallback might change p95 by 2-3x; clients should get `latency_budget_ms` so they can decide (retry, degrade, or surface error).

sasha: Also a must: emit an audit event when fallback happens with tenant, original_model, fallback_model, reason, and timestamp. This feeds billing/quality alerts.

maria: Action items from thread: (1) define handshake schema and example payload (maria) (2) add `allow_fallback` flag in Console + tenant profile (devon) (3) add audit events and retention policy (sasha) (4) add `latency_budget_ms` and client opt-out (nate).

lee: :thumbsup: I'll prototype the handshake state-machine in the runtime shim and mock a hosted fallback route.

nate: If someone wants to pair on the schema or the edge cases (privacy-only tenants) ping me and we can sketch the JSON contract.
